title: MCPVP TierTagger
description: Adds a tier tagger to mcpvp.com
body:
# TierTagger

nametag-tiering mod!

This mod is not officaly supported by **mcpvp.com**

![this shouldnt appear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/aFly1NLD/images/0aa5316a32b1602478535af14631f776374204d5.png)

NOTE: This mod depends on ukulib to work!

TierTagger is a mod that displays a player's PvP Tier in their nametag. TierTagger supports all MCPvP game modes. The default gamemode to display is configurable. If a player is unranked in a specified game mode, TierTagger will display their highest Tier overall.

TierTagger also has a built-in system to view a player's profile!


## Forking

You are allowed to fork this mod and repurpose it for your own tierlists, under a few conditions:

- The mod is licensed under the MPL-2.0, which means you need to keep your fork open source with the same license and give proper credit to the original work
